label: Credential bundle omission controls
paraphrase: Five structural interpretations of the same five-member bundle: with a reason and its presentation, an empty credential relation omits credentialing; a flat credential with empty priority omits prior transfer; a natural-number successor credential chain satisfies strict transitive prior transfer but omits well-foundedness; an unpresented thin reason omits presentation; and an empty reason frame omits thin reason existence. The well-foundedness omission is infinite, the others finite. These are not claims of actual epistemic adequacy or possible metaphysics.
